evidence.title: I gave Qwen 3.8 27B a reverse-engineering job and it finished in 30 minutes

summary: Researchers gave the Qwen 3.8 27‑billion‑parameter model a reverse‑engineering challenge, and it produced results in just half an hour. The rapid performance highlights the model's strong reasoning and problem‑solving abilities, sparking interest in its potential applications.
title: Qwen 3.8 27B completes reverse‑engineering task in 30 minutes
